summary: The note describes Saint Petersburg Governorate, an administrative division (a guberniya) that existed from 1708 to 1927. It served under the Tsardom of Russia, the Russian Empire, and the Russian SFSR. The note is a short stub giving only the basic definition and dates.
one_line: Saint Petersburg Governorate was a Russian administrative division (guberniya) that existed from 1708 to 1927 across three successive states.
key_facts: Saint Petersburg Governorate was an administrative division called a "guberniya" in Russian.
The governorate is also referred to as the Government of Saint Petersburg.
The Saint Petersburg Governorate existed during 1708–1927.
It was part of the Tsardom of Russia.
It was part of the Russian Empire.
It was part of the Russian SFSR.
The Russian name of the governorate is "Sankt-Peterburgskaya guberniya".
